title: Are Evolutionary Algorithms Safe Optimizers?
reasoning: The paper discusses 'safe optimization problems' where 'safety constraints' are related to avoiding irrevocable physical loss or damage (e.g., breakage of equipment, loss of human life) during an optimization process. This is a technical definition of safety (e.g., functional safety, system safety) rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical principles in the broader sense of AI ethics.
